title: IT Support Specialist and software operator
description:
**Position:** IT Support Specialist (SOFTWARE ,HARDWARE , NETWORKING, DIGITAL MARKETING)

**Location:** Ahmedabad, GJ (onsite)

**Role Overview:**  
The IT Support Specialist will play a key role in managing day-to-day IT operations and providing technical support for employees. This role ensures smooth functioning of hardware, software, and network systems while troubleshooting issues to minimize downtime. Require candidate who can operate/give support for in-house hospital software.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Technical Support:**
* *Provide first-level IT support to employees via in-person, calls, or remote assistance.*
* *Troubleshoot hardware and software issues for desktops, laptops, printers, and peripherals.*
* *Assist users with basic queries related to software tools (e.g., MS Office, MS Teams, Remote Desktop).*
* **System Maintenance:**
* *Install, update, and configure software applications and operating systems.*
* *Perform routine maintenance checks to ensure system efficiency.*
* *Monitor system backups and ensure data security.*
* **Network Support:**
* *Assist in monitoring and troubleshooting network connectivity issues (LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi).*
* *Coordinate with the IT vendor for critical network and server issues.*
* **Asset Management:**
* *Track and maintain IT inventory, including laptops, desktops, software licenses, and accessories.*
* *Facilitate timely hardware upgrades and replacements.*
* **Security & Compliance:**
* *Ensure systems adhere to security protocols and data privacy policies.*
* *Monitor antivirus, firewall settings, and endpoint security.*
* *Report and document any IT-related breaches or vulnerabilities.*
* **User Training & Documentation:**
* *Assist in onboarding new employees by setting up IT systems and credentials.*
* *Create user manuals and provide basic IT training for employees.*
* **Collaboration:**
* *Coordinate with cross-functional teams for IT requirements and system updates.*
* *Liaise with external vendors for technical assistance as needed.*

**Requirements:**

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field.
* **Experience:** 1-2 years in IT support or similar role.
* **Skills:**
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Knowledge of Windows OS, MS Office Suite, and Remote Desktop tools.
* Familiarity with basic networking concepts.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: IT Resume Specialist
description:
Resume Writer

**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** Ahmedabad  
**Experience:** 1–3 years  
**Industry:** IT Recruitment / Career Services  
**Shift:** Overnight(US time zone)

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled **Resume Writer** who can create, improve, and customize professional resumes for IT professionals. The ideal candidate should understand different IT roles, be able to identify candidates' key skills and experience, and present them effectively in ATS\-friendly resumes.

Key Responsibilities

* Create and update professional, ATS\-friendly resumes for IT candidates.
* Review candidates' experience, skills, projects, and career goals.
* Customize resumes according to specific IT job descriptions.
* Highlight relevant technical skills, achievements, and experience.
* Ensure resumes are professionally formatted, accurate, and easy to read.
* Optimize resumes with relevant keywords for ATS systems.
* Rewrite existing resumes to improve their impact and presentation.
* Work with recruiters and candidates to gather required information.
* Maintain quality and consistency across all resumes.
* Complete resumes within assigned timelines and meet daily/weekly targets.

Requirements

* 1–3 years of experience in resume writing, career services, recruitment, or a related field.
* Excellent written English and strong grammar skills.
* Strong knowledge of professional resume formatting and ATS optimization.
* Good understanding of IT/technical roles such as Software Developer, Data Engineer, DevOps, Cloud, Cybersecurity, QA, etc.
* Ability to understand technical experience and convert it into strong resume content.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Good communication and organizational skills.
* Ability to work with deadlines and handle multiple candidates.

Preferred Skills

* Experience creating resumes for the **US job market**.
* Familiarity with US IT recruitment and job descriptions.
* Experience using resume\-building or document\-formatting tools.
* Knowledge of ATS systems and keyword optimization.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary.
* Performance\-based incentives.
* Professional growth opportunities.
* Training and development.
* Dynamic and collaborative work environment.
* Opportunity to work with IT professionals and US\-based recruitment processes.

Work Location: In person

title: System Administrator
